_doc: AUTHORED reading of Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35 for the background behind Prairie Avenue: Calumet Avenue's west frontage, 20th to 22nd Street (T-3018, piece 1 of T-3010, piece 3 of T-2983), which tools/census_prairie_1904_background.py ranks behind Calumet 18th-20th among the Calumet faces (21st-22nd: 6 of 6 lots seen, 2140 from 20 stands; 20th-21st: 4 of 6). The T-1842 census (chicago/prairie_1904_v1/data/sheet_census/sheet-35.json) counts Prairie frontages only, so these ten rows are read here, in the same frontage contract, for tools/trace_prairie_1904_footprints.py (sheet '35e') and tools/draft_prairie_1904.py. 2008 and 2018 Calumet are not here: they are the named Hanford and Wheeler-Kohn houses, edges_census_s35.json's (T-2982). 2016 is read and drafted though no Prairie stand sees it, so the frontage stands whole.

reading.by: Read by eye from the committed sheet 35 scan (1602 x 2000 px) at 3x over the Calumet lots and 8x over 2032's storey figure, 2026-10-22.
reading.conventions: Sanborn colour: pink brick, blue stone, yellow frame. A crossed square marks a stable. D = dwelling. Storey figures as printed (B = basement, S.B. as printed).
reading.limits: A 1911 label is a 1911 observation (study ruling 11): the six alley buildings lettered GARAGE, VACANT or REPAIRING & GARAGE are backcast as stables. 2128's diagonal wash is read as the sheet draws it (stone and brick), not as a material split on the plan. No dimension is claimed beyond the trace.

polygons.reading_1911: 3B brick dwelling (D) on the 20th Street corner with a canted bay on its Calumet front, a one-storey frame porch at its north-east corner, a 3B rear part behind a dashed line and a one-storey frame strip along the rear part's north side
2-storey brick building on the alley lettered VACANT, dashed inside
polygons.note_1904: A 1911 'vacant' building is a 1911 state; the alley building of a corner house, backcast as the lot's stable.

frontages.why: No named record or 1904 directory row for this lot is in the T-1837 study, and no earlier plan of this block face is in hand, so the 1911 sheet is the only plan: the draft stands the sheet's house for 1904 as background, its presence inferred from the sheet alone (study ruling 11) under the block's single liberty.
